verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style operation evidenced is automatic: recording a deployment (via the deploy API or `honeybadger deploy` CLI) marks all unresolved errors as resolved at once. Beyond that, the evidence shows listing and searching faults plus single-item actions like resolving one error from Slack, but no user-directed bulk actions on a chosen set of items. missing for 10: explicit bulk resolve/assign/tag/delete on selected or query-matched errors via UI, API, or MCP; documented batch endpoints; hands-on corroboration.
